inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read the Ascendant in Your Chart
inline.titleEn: How to Find Your Ascendant in 5 Steps
inline.titleZh: 五步找到你的上升星座
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence: gather accurate birth time, cast the chart, note rising sign and degree, trace house cusps, read instinct and structure
inline.altZh: 五步流程：收集精确出生时间、绘制星盘、记录上升星座与度数、追踪宫位、阅读本能与结构

items.subEn: To the minute if possible; near a sign boundary each minute can shift the rising sign
items.subZh: 尽量精确到分钟；靠近星座边界时每分钟都可能改变上升星座

items.subEn: Use exact time and place; the ascendant appears at the left, 9-o'clock point of the wheel
items.subZh: 使用精确时间和地点；上升点位于星盘左侧九点钟位置

items.subEn: That sign and degree is your rising sign and your first house cusp
items.subZh: 该星座与度数即为你的上升星座和第一宫宫头

items.subEn: Number the house cusps around from the ascendant; watch how each life domain is assigned
items.subZh: 从上升点依次标记各宫位宫头；观察每个生活领域的分配

items.subEn: Rising sign for instinct and first impression; house cusps for structural payoff across the whole chart
items.subZh: 上升星座揭示本能与第一印象；宫位则是整张星盘结构意义的关键
